title: Shasqi presented 2 posters at the 2024 Society for Immunotherapy of Cancer (SITC) Annual Meeting
body_markdown:
Shasqi presented two clinical posters at the Society for Immunotherapy of Cancer (SITC) Annual Meeting on November 9, 2024 in Houston, Texas.


View the abstracts below:


[Attenuated MMAE Therapeutic Activated by Click Chemistry at the Tumor Evokes Potent Immune Responses](https://jitc.bmj.com/content/12/Suppl_2/A1433)


[Doxorubicin-Based Click Chemistry Therapeutic Activates Potent Cytotoxic Immune Responses in Advanced Sarcoma Patients in a Phase 1/2a Clinical Trial](https://jitc.bmj.com/content/12/Suppl_2/A718)
